_comment: Copy the org-specific keys below into appsettings.Development.json (gitignored) for local dev, or set them as environment variables (e.g. AzureAd__ClientSecret) in production. Never commit real values here.
_azureAdComment: This app registration is also used app-only (client credentials) for the guest re-validation background job — grant it Graph 'User.Read.All', and 'GroupMember.Read.All' if Gating.AllowedGroupIds is used, with admin consent.
_uniFiComment: ApiKey is a Site Manager API key (unifi.ui.com → Settings → API Keys) unless UseCloudConnector is false. ConsoleId comes from GET https://api.ui.com/v1/hosts; SiteId is a UUID from GET .../network/integration/v1/sites (match on internalReference), not the 'default' slug. GuestNetworkCidr is required for the anonymous guest path — UniFi's client API reports a connected device's IP but not its SSID/VLAN, so this is how the app verifies a guest-authorize request actually comes from the guest network's own subnet (not e.g. the internal one).

_forwardedHeadersComment: TrustAllProxies must only be true when this app sits exclusively behind a single trusted reverse proxy/ingress that strips client-supplied X-Forwarded-* headers (e.g. an OpenShift Route) — otherwise a client can spoof X-Forwarded-Proto and bypass HTTPS redirection. Leave false for local dev and any deployment exposing Kestrel directly.
